entries.zh: 依；据〔汉栏作“根深”（字面：根子深），与词头 según 对应待考〕
entries.notes: 西语词头 Segun~ 与汉栏“根深”音义均不合，官话栏空白，条目对应关系无法定夺。

entries.zh: 安稳；牢固〔西语文句残乱、音栏有污损（T99），释义存疑〕
entries.en: safe, secure; to secure oneself [Spanish garbled, entry damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语栏讹形连篇（aseigurarse、puenta 等），音栏含 T99 污损记号，汉栏“担橋脚尖／落當”与西语对应不明。

entries.zh: 酉；地支第十位（酉时，约午后五至七时，对译西语“午后六时”）
entries.en: yu, the tenth earthly branch; the afternoon double-hour 5–7 p.m. (for 'six of the afternoon')

entries.zh: 暮（傍晚）〔与西语“晨间四至六时”相抵，疑原字为“卯”（卯时，晨五至七时）〕
entries.en: dusk/evening (as transcribed); the Spanish 'from 4 to 6 in the morning' suggests the morning double-hour 5–7 a.m.
entries.notes: 汉栏“暮”（傍晚）与西语晨间时刻相抵，音栏首读合“卯”之常音，疑形近误辨，降为中置信。

entries.zh: 一年中的前六个月；上半年〔汉栏“穩冬”待考〕
entries.en: the first six months of the year; the earlier half-year (Chinese column unclear)
entries.notes: 仅西语栏“年内前六月”可解，汉栏“穩冬”与音栏两音无通行对应词，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to seal; to close/seal up (a letter, document)

entries.zh: 印记号；印信的标记、印文
entries.en: seal mark; the device or inscription of a seal

entries.zh: 谒（拜见）〔与西语 sello 及音栏不合，字迹难辨，释义存疑〕
entries.en: a seal [H column reads 謁 'to pay a visit', mismatched with the seal sense; entry doubtful]
entries.notes: 汉栏“謁”之常音与音写、西语 sello 均不合，疑字迹误辨（或为“符”），语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 过印；钤印（文书、货物加盖印记）
entries.en: to pass/impress a seal; stamped (on documents or goods)

entries.zh: 印绶；官印及系印之绶带
entries.en: official seal with its silk ribbon/cord; seal of office
entries.notes: 西语栏空白，仅据汉栏“印綬”与音写两音释义。

entries.zh: 护书；书信之封护、封缄（护住信函之物）
entries.en: seal/cover of a letter; that which protects the letter

entries.zh: 护书之用〔首字印作“謁”而音写同前条“護”，条目存疑〕
entries.en: for sealing/protecting letters [first character doubtful; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 首字“謁”与音写不合（音同前条“護”），末音疑为“用”，全条语义难以定夺。
